## Change safety

- [ ] Affected feature contracts and persistence keys are identified.
- [ ] Characterization/regression tests were added before high-conflict extraction.
- [ ] Shared mutations use canonical domain commands; surface adapters have equivalent effects.
- [ ] Move → Function → Lens terminology and migration compatibility are preserved.
- [ ] Companion and extension parity/fallbacks are real and tested.
- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes, including browser evidence and generated matrix.
- [ ] No capability was deleted/renamed without approval, migration, and deprecation evidence.
- [ ] Requirements ledger has zero unresolved local items.
